case_definition: Meningococcal meningitis is an explicitly typed subset of invasive meningococcal disease. Keep this source series distinct; no subtype rollup. Original ICD: A39.0. Native monthly new notifications or source-verified table-specific weekly notifications. Cumulative, sex-specific and estimated measurements cannot supply incident case curves. Preserve source calendar, case definition, ICD label, explicit zeros and missingness; never sum states, strata, weekly/monthly/annual or reporting systems.
provenance_note: Registered source observations are retained for provenance and downloads, but their measure is not eligible for the public cases curve.
